_source: production Kodi profile at Gate MA1 start: runtime /var/tmp/kodi-home/.kodi/userdata/guisettings.xml, seeded from config/kodi/guisettings-appliance.xml at commit 1d3284dc8269144963ac79c9da0e5f0b331bb216
_note: 'default' means the value carried Kodi's own default marker (default="true") and was not pinned by the appliance profile.
_usedisplayasclock_finding: Already false before MA1 touched anything. CVideoPlayerAudio computes allowpassthrough = !usedisplayasclock, so a true here would have disabled compressed output in code; it did not, and no change to it was needed. The per-codec flags above were all at Kodi's permissive defaults but were dead: audiooutput.passthrough was false, and the sink enumerated with no passthrough-capable device at all.
